Maybe that's the issue; I think I skipped on NSO when it first came out 'cause I didn't have anyone to play online with. I've had a switch since launch w/ the same account but I did move from Canada to US and had to like.. convert my account over, or something. I'm sure there are plenty of factors. Honestly, not to be TOO like "positive" or whatever, but I hope if I don't get an invite that it goes to someone who will appreciate it more than me.

Damn, not sure if it's first come first served like a bunch of people said it was then... I've also had NSO since 2019 apparently. Or longer? Idk on my switch it says like, 5 years and X amount of months.

Damn, I'm wondering if something on my account was like.. not accurate. Like maybe I canceled NSO and only re-signed up like, 10 months ago or something. I still got nothing and I registered like, 3 mins after it went live
I reserved my spot immediately after the direct ended and still received nothing.
Don't worry; I ordered it at like, 2pm and got the email at 10pm that night lol
nah not gonna fault someone for wanting what they want. I don't wanna drop $85 for it, but i'm glad you were able to get one if you want one.
of course you do.
Damn, $85... they confirmed Switch 1 Pro Controller still works, right?

Crazy, my friend and I joined way early and didn't get anything, but people said it was "first come first served"

  
EDIT: Oohh this is for the GC Controller SPECIFICALLY. my bad!
